data.critiqueText: Building complex auth & custom dashboards for Calc with Next.js, Supabase, Node, Vercel in 24 Hours will burn time. Cut bloat features immediately! Focus 100% on the core interactive loop.

sprintPlan.title: Primary User Flow UI
sprintPlan.desc: Build dynamic UI views for Calc.

sprintPlan.title: Demo Script & Backup Video
sprintPlan.desc: Record 60s backup walkthrough video & seed database.

risks.title: API Delay & Mocking Blocker
risks.desc: Frontend waiting on real backend endpoints.
risks.action: > COACH INTERVENTION: Implement mock JSON responses directly in frontend service.

risks.title: Deployment Cold Start Failure
risks.action: > COACH INTERVENTION: Deploy early to Vercel/Render at Hour 4 to test CORS.

recoveryPlan.headline: Emergency Scope Cut & Pivot Protocol
steps: Drop custom auth — use hardcoded guest user context.
Freeze UI tweaks at Hour 18 — verify 1-click happy path demo flow.
Save pre-computed JSON snapshots locally in case live APIs timeout.

architecture.feedback: Strong technical stack with Next.js. Ensure DB is pre-seeded with sample data.

checklist: 1-click Guest Demo Mode enabled without auth prompt?
Live API error handling displays friendly fallback state?

judgeSimulation.feedback: Judges will praise solving a real pain point if live demo delivers instantaneous visual impact.

sampleQuestions.q: How does your system handle offline network failures during live demo?
sampleQuestions.a: Our application uses an embedded local fallback engine that serves pre-cached data instantly.

sampleQuestions.q: Why is this team capable of taking this product further?
sampleQuestions.a: We established modular separation between core API logic and presentation layers.
